newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 6.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* Federal jury in New York convicts three in a conspiracy to bomb airliners.
* Russian President Boris Yeltsin to undergo heart surgery.
* United States says Iraq is pulling out of Kurdish enclave but leaving spies behind.
* New York school overcrowding to last for years to come, officials say.
* Suspect in police officer's killing hangs himself in jail cell.
* Poll shows most Americans give President Bill Clinton credit on the economy.
* Many New York city workers authorised to drive do not have valid licences.
